settings.title: Scrub
settings.body: Start with Mish Lip Scrub. A gentle swipe of tallow and sugar wakes up your lips, buffs away dryness, and signals to your mind: this moment is yours.

settings.heading: Your 3-Step Ritual
settings.subheading: Designed to fit inside the life you already have. No extra time needed.

settings.quote: I created this for the woman who gives everyone her best — and saves nothing for herself.
settings.body:
As a busy professional woman — and a mom — I know what it's like to run on empty. To look in the mirror and not recognize yourself anymore. Not because you've aged, but because you've simply stopped showing up for you.

I didn't want a 10-step routine. I wanted something real, luxurious, and fast. So I built it. Three products that work together as a ritual: scrub, hydrate, breathe. That's it. That's enough.

You are worthy of care. This drop is for you.
